source.decision: George, project thread: parallel DR (DR joins at step 2); renumber DC rules in run order; fix the gaps found by the overall review; organize data written in document text and check it for duplicates and conflicts.

renumbering.kept: Decision tokens such as USER_APPROVED_2026-10-09_DC005_REVIEW, earlier review records and history notes keep the numbers in force when they were written; each rule records previous_id.

gaps_found: DR read the inventory before writing requirements, so requirements could follow what the files held rather than the objective, and DR waited for the inventory.
An item left NEEDS_REVIEW was never read and raised no finding.
A DATA requirement supported only by document or note text passed although preparation reads tables only.
Two copies of one dataset (two tables, or a table restated in a document) were labelled and counted separately.
Data values written in text were not organized, so they could not be checked against tables or carried to preparation.
changes: dr_requirements.json 1.1.0: DR001 (call DR) defines tasks and requirements from the reviewed context alongside the inventory; DR002 (call DR-access) assigns access after both.
workflow_runtime.py: data_requirements_agent writes requirement_definition.json; new data_access_agent writes requirements.json; data_label_agents waits for it.
dc_coverage.json 2.0.0: rules renumbered in run order with previous_id and step; 2.1.0: DC003 stated values, DC005 text-only data and stated-value repeats.
data_agents.py: define and assign_access; ITEM_NOT_REVIEWED, DATA_NOT_IN_TABLE and POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_DATA findings; stated values listed, compared and written to stated_values.json at preparation.
tests: parallel DR fixture, per-call rule lists, the three gap checks and stated values.
